message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('test/api/fonts/clusterfuzz-testcase-minimized-hb-subset-fuzzer-5609911946838016')
data=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
# mutate last 16 bytes to create odd offsets / lengths
for variant, tail in enumerate([
    bytes.fromhex('00000001000000010000000100000001'),
    bytes.fromhex('ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff'),
    bytes.fromhex('00000020000000200000002000000020'),
    bytes.fromhex('00010002000300040005000600070008'),
]):
    out=Path(f'/tmp/poc{variant}')
    d=bytearray(data)
    d[-16:]=tail
    out.write_bytes(d)
    print(out, len(d), d[-16:].hex())
PY
for f in /tmp/poc0 /tmp/poc1 /tmp/poc2 /tmp/poc3; do echo '---' $f; cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
